src.name: Wikipedia · Tracey Emin
src.q: In 1987, Emin moved to London to study at the Royal College of Art, where in 1989 she obtained an MA in painting.

notes.name: Wikipedia · Tracey Emin
notes.q: Emin displayed six small watercolours in her Turner Prize exhibition in 1999 and also in her New York show Every Part of Me's Bleeding held that same year, known as the Berlin Watercolour series (1998).

notes.name: Wikipedia · Tracey Emin
notes.q: In 1999, Emin had her first solo exhibition in the United States at Lehmann Maupin Gallery, entitled Every Part of Me's Bleeding.

notes.name: Wikipedia · Tracey Emin
notes.q: Two years later, in 1999, Emin was shortlisted for the Turner Prize herself and exhibited My Bed at the Tate Gallery.
